blurb: Discover the heart of Yakima Valley wine country at Fortuity Cellars, our family-owned winery in Wapato, WA. We invite you to join us for a personal wine tasting where every visit is hosted by the owners and winemakers. Our wines are crafted with love from Washington State’s most distinctive vineyards.
